stem:
Leena must measure the length of a curved path drawn on paper.

Which methods measure the curved length correctly? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Lay a thread along the curve, mark the ends, straighten the thread, and measure it on a scale.
Place a straight scale along a chord of the curve and call that length the curved path.
Fit several short straight scale segments along the curve and add those lengths.
Say a curved path cannot be measured with a scale or thread.

teacher.key_rationale: A curved length can be taken with thread along the curve then measured straight, or by adding short straight segments along the curve. A single chord is not the curved path. Curved lengths are measurable.
